types.name: QuoteControl
docs: Admin-managed list of quote mints that may back bonding curves, each with the
initial virtual quote reserves used when a curve is created against it.
The global authority assigns `admin`; the admin assigns `reserves_admin`.
The account starts with room for 50 entries and is reallocated when it fills.

fields.name: admin
docs: May add or remove quote mints and rotate the reserves admin.

fields.name: reserves_admin
docs: May only update the initial virtual quote reserves of listed mints.
